decisions.reason: After surviving the first review, this heater benefits from added sunk development and market-commitment effects, but because it is still not a stated strategic pillar and is easier to sacrifice if performance stays mediocre, its withdrawal risk remains moderate.

This multi-model industrial line is closely tied to the firm's core customer needs and, having already been maintained once, is now further protected by escalation of commitment and by management's ability to interpret any weak results as temporary.
